2: A song. A psalm of Asaph. O God, do not rest silently. Do not keep silent or be still, O God.
3: For look, your enemies roar, and those who hate you have lifted their head.
4: They devise cunning schemes against your people, and consult together against your protected ones.
5: They say, “Come, let us annihilate them from being a nation, so that the name of Israel will be remembered no more.”
6: For they have consulted together ⌞with a unified purpose⌟. They have made a covenant against you:
7: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
8: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the inhabitants of Tyre.
9: Assyria also has joined with them. They ⌞provide help⌟ to the children of Lot. Selah
10: Do to them as you did with Midian, as with Sisera, as with Jabin at the wadi of Kishon.
11: They were destroyed at En-dor; they became dung for the ground.
12: Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their chiefs like Zebah and Zalmunna,
13: who said, “Let us take as our possession the pastures of God.”
14: O my God, make them like the tumbleweed, like the chaff before wind.
15: As fire burns a forest, and as a flame sets afire mountains,
16: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.
17: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek your name, O Yahweh.
18: Let them be ashamed and terrified forever, and let them be humiliated and perish
19: that they may know that you, whose name is Yahweh, you alone, are the Most High over the whole earth.
